purpose: Translate current creative AI workspace competition into Arcanea product and metrics requirements.

sources.observedJob: Editable writing/coding canvas for iterative work.
Project workspaces with chats, files, instructions, memory, and tools.
Shareable standalone artifacts for apps, tools, content, and visualizations.
Self-contained project workspaces with chat histories, documents, and context.
Motion quality, prompt adherence, visual fidelity, and complex instruction execution.
Worldbuilding tools for wiki articles, maps, timelines, RPG campaigns, and novel writing.
Feature depth across articles, templates, maps, timelines, and organization.

capabilityPressure.userExpectation: Users expect generation to become an editable workspace, not a one-shot chat response.
Users expect long-running projects to remember files, instructions, and context.
Users expect outputs that can be shared, remixed, exported, or reused.
Users expect high visual fidelity, prompt adherence, reference continuity, and motion control.
Worldbuilders expect structured records, maps, timelines, templates, and campaign/novel continuity.
Modern AI tools need clear status, release posture, and privacy-safe instrumentation.

arcaneaNorthStar: A user arrives, names a Drift, receives a Gift, sets Right Use, creates a proof artifact, and leaves with memory/provenance/workflow momentum rather than only a chat transcript.
